body:
Vendors the console build for [objectui#1619](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/pull/1619) — dataset-bound dashboard widgets now render the measure display **label** (`Tasks`), **formatted** values (`$616,000`), and a **consistent metric card**. Pairs with [#1683](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/framework/pull/1683) (`AnalyticsResult.fields` label/format), already merged.

Browser-verified on the showcase Chart Gallery. `.objectui-sha` only (vendored `packages/console/dist` is gitignored, regenerated by `scripts/build-console.sh`).
